name: Tier 5 decision reduction to safe autonomous action
purpose: Provides high-confidence DomainFindings across all three lifecycle domains with a verified causal claim corroborated in two domains, so the Phase-6 fixture runner can drive Tier 5 (DecisionReducer) and the downstream Action Validation gate to a published safe autonomous action: DecisionRecord (safe_autonomous), ProposedAction (proposed -> validated -> executed in-record), ActionValidation (allowed). The escalation counterpart remains FIXTURE-002.

event.summary: Corroborated causal diagnosis of an auth-service outage supports a safe autonomous remediation decision

domain_findings.summary: Aggregated 1 EvidenceShard(s) for the code domain (CodeIntelligenceManager); verified causal claim present.
supported_claims: verified: reverting the auth-service config change caused the error rate to recover
the deployed changeset touches the authentication request path

domain_findings.summary: Aggregated 1 EvidenceShard(s) for the delivery domain (DeliveryHealthManager); corroborates the code-domain causal claim.
supported_claims: verified: reverting the auth-service config change caused the error rate to recover
the build pipeline reported zero blocking failures for the changeset

domain_findings.summary: Aggregated 1 EvidenceShard(s) for the production domain (ProductionHealthManager); recovery observed post-revert.
supported_claims: the auth-service error rate recovered after the revert
the staging deployment preceded the auth-service error spike
